faq: How much does Higgsfield cost?

Free is $0 with no monthly credits. Starter is $19/month for 270 credits. Plus is $59/month for 1,200 credits and Ultra is $129/month for 3,000 credits, going up to $375/month for 9,000. During the Black Friday offer, yearly billing is $30/month for Plus and from $45/month for Ultra.
How do Higgsfield credits work?

Each model uses a set number of credits per generation, depending on the model, the length and the resolution. For example Seedance 2.5 at 720p uses 35 credits per 5 seconds of video, and Nano Banana Pro uses 2 credits per image. Subscription credits do not roll over and expire at the end of each credit cycle.
Is Higgsfield free?
Yes. The Free plan gives limited access to selected AI models, no monthly credits and one generation at a time. Commercial use is not included on Free.
Can I buy more credits?
Yes. You can upgrade to a plan with more credits or buy credit packs without changing your subscription. Paid plans get credit top-ups at a discount.
